title: ci(queue): watch the merge queue's required-check set
body:
Fixes #9422

`main`'s merge queue requires nine check contexts. That set lives in GitHub ruleset 11776024 — repository settings. Removing a member reds no gate, fires no alarm, and leaves no trace in any diff a reviewer reads. This adds the one thing in the tree that looks at it.

## The premise, re-measured rather than inherited

**Confirmed.** `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` answers HTTP 200 with all five rule types and the nine contexts, `Type Check` among them (nonsense control `Type Checq` → absent, in the same run).

**Falsified, and it is the card's own ⭐ fact:** the card said the endpoint reads with an *ordinary session token, no admin scope*, and asked me to verify that. **I cannot, from this seat, and neither could the card.** The controls say why:

| request | HTTP | body |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `rules/branches/main` with the session token | 200 | the 9 contexts |
| same, with `Authorization: Bearer ghp_definitelynotarealtoken000000000000` | **200** | byte-identical |
| same, with **no** `Authorization` header | **200** | byte-identical |
| `/user` with no `Authorization` header | **200** | `login: baozhoutao` |
| `/rate_limit` with no `Authorization` header | 200 | `limit: 15000` |

The agent egress proxy injects credentials regardless of what this seat sends, so *every* token-scope reading taken here is a **broken instrument** — a control that cannot fail is not a control. That does not sink the card: the endpoint demonstrably answers the shape, and the failure direction is safe. A token that lacks the scope produces exit 2 (CANNOT READ) and a red job, never a green one. **The scope question is settled by the patrol's first live run, not by this PR**, and it is written into the script header as unmeasured rather than dressed up.

## The three open questions, decided

**1. Where it runs → a daily scheduled workflow, no PR leg.** Following `merge-queue-head-patrol.yml`, which is this repo's precedent for anything network-dependent: schedule plus `workflow_dispatch`, offline `--self-test` on every PR, live transport proven by dispatch. Fork PRs and offline runs therefore never arise — there is no PR leg to inherit them from. One API call a day.

⛔ A `merge_group` leg is ruled out by something sharper than cost: a check outside the required set does not gate the queue, and putting *this* check inside it would make the gate that watches the required set the thing whose silent removal it exists to detect. **The required set can never be self-watching.** That is the argument for an out-of-band clock, and it is in the workflow header.

**2. What it pins → `Type Check` only, as the triage ruled.** Plus a leg the ruling did not contemplate and which cannot manufacture the red it was protecting against: the rule **types** `merge_queue` and `required_status_checks` must be present. `Type Check ∈ required_status_checks` says nothing if the queue rule is gone, and a rule type is not a job name, so no rename can move it.

The other eight are `WATCHED_CONTEXTS`: reported in the run summary, red nothing. The measurement behind the split, `git log -S` over `.github/workflows/` on `origin/main` — each of `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration` has one count-changing commit, `Lint` has two (`6bdb970a04`, 2026-02-18), and the **shard shape has already moved once**: `71be244d52` introduced the 4-way matrix on 2026-07-17 and `9f7d786bdc` later split the coverage lane into its own four. Nonsense control `name: Type Checq` → 0 commits; known-direction control `name: Test (coverage shard` → 1, so the instrument finds later shape changes.

⚠️ **The failure mode accepted, stated plainly:** a silent removal of any of the eight watched contexts is made **observable, not enforced**. Eight ninths of the set is reported and fails nothing. Promoting one is a one-line move between the two lists and a maintainer's call.

**3. objectstack → not touched.** Out of scope by the card's own words. Nothing in this PR reaches outside this repository.

## ⭐ What watches the gate

The card's own complaint, one level up, so it is answered in four parts rather than assumed:

1. **The logic** — `scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` runs offline on every PR, including the ablation below.
2. **The wiring** — that same test pins this workflow's existence, its `schedule`, its permissions and the script it calls; and `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` independently requires the section and inventory row added here. Deleting the patrol, or quietly removing its clock, fails a pull request. This is the half of its liveness a diff can see.
3. **The transport** — a reading that could not be taken is exit 2 and a RED job. A lost token, a moved endpoint or an outage is loud, never a silent green.
4. ⚠️ **The residual, declared and not dissolved** — GitHub delaying or dropping scheduled runs, and an admin disabling the workflow in the Actions UI, are invisible from inside the tree. That is genuinely the same class as the gap this closes, and it is left as an open question on #9422 rather than papered over. Two measurements bound it: the 60-day-**inactivity** rule that disables schedules is nowhere near holding (`origin/main` took **3392** commits in the last 60 days; the longest gap between consecutive commits over the most recent 400 was **0.13 days**), and the reader is **stateless** — every run re-reads full current membership, never a delta — so a dropped tick costs detection latency and never coverage.

## ⭐ The ablation: the gate is observed failing

`scripts/__tests__/fixtures/required-check-set/live-2026-09-14.json` is the byte-real API response. `type-check-removed.json` is that same response with exactly one member removed; a test asserts the two differ by `Type Check` and by nothing else.

| leg | command | exit |
|:--|:--|--:|
| **control** | `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs --fixture …/live-2026-09-14.json` | **0** (INTACT) |
| **ablation** | `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs --fixture …/type-check-removed.json` | **3** (BREACHED) |
| control | `QUEUE_BASE_BRANCH=zzz-no-such-branch-9422` (the endpoint answers `200 []`) | **3** |
| control | `GITHUB_REPOSITORY=objectstack-ai/no-such-repo-9422` | **2**, never 0 |
| live | the real endpoint, real `main` | **0** (INTACT, 9 contexts) |

A second ablation checks that the **test** is live, not just the gate. Blinding the evaluator (`missingPinned = []`, mutation proved on disk: injected token 1, removed token 0, blob `74f2718…` → `afb3516…`) turns the suite red — 3 failed / 16 passed — and the self-test fails 8 of its 32 cases. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`, proved by `git diff HEAD` being empty and the blob returning to `74f2718…`.

## ⛔ The honest limit, carried forward and not upgraded

> across all **94** merge-queue rejections measured on this repo, the failing job is **always a Test shard — never `Type Check`**

The queue has therefore **never been observed rejecting on a type failure specifically**, and this PR does not claim otherwise. #3535's dev refused to infer from configuration that the leg would fire; that refusal stands, is written into the script header in those terms, and is **not** resolvable from the queue's history. It cuts one way only: the `Type Check` leg is untested in practice, so its silent removal is the removal least likely to be noticed.

## ⚠️ A standing claim this contradicts — reported, not swept up

Three places say this surface cannot be read from here:

- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: *"nothing in this repository can do it, and nothing here can read the current state of it either"*
- `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml`: *"a repository-SETTINGS surface nothing here can read or change"*
- `AGENTS.md`: *"从仓内读不到"*

The **write** half is unchanged and this PR does not touch it — the patrol never enrols, removes or renames a context, and issues exactly one GET. The **read** half is true of an offline test and false of a job with network. The doc section added here says so in place; the other two sentences are left alone and flagged as a finding rather than edited from a card that does not hold them. That belief is plausibly *why* nothing was watching this set.

## Scope and verdicts

- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over all 7 paths → **exit 0, NOT GOVERNED** (7 paths vs 5 governed surfaces, none matched). Control `AGENTS.md` → exit 3, GOVERNED, so the instrument hits.
- ⛔ Nothing enrols, removes or changes a required context, and the ruleset is not touched.
- Changeset: empty frontmatter — tooling and CI only, no package released. ⛔ No `skip-changeset` label (that label is inert in this repo).
- `Bundle Analysis` is red across this lane and is not required — not addressed here.

## Tests

| check | exit |
|:--|--:|
| `pnpm check:required-check-set` (32 self-test cases) | 0 |
| vitest: the new suite + `ci-cd-pipeline-doc` + `merge-queue-reporting` + `dependabot-merge-gate` + `entry-guard-wiring` + `check-pre-install-import-graph` — **6 files, 195 tests** | 0 |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `check:control-bytes`, `check:action-ref-convention`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:merge-queue-head`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:changeset-claims`, `docs:check-links`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 each |

Every exit code above was captured by redirect-then-capture, never across a pipe.

The typecheck was proved to actually compile the new test — `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --listFiles` names it once, and the control `packages/core/src/index.ts` zero times, so a green reading is a measurement rather than a skip.

Lint is a **declared narrowing**, run at `18823a533e`: eslint over the two files this diff adds reports **0 errors, 0 warnings** across 2 files (count read from `--format json`, not estimated). The root population eslint itself enumerates is **353 files**, of which both new files are members. Type-aware linting is **not** enabled (no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project` in `eslint.config.js`; control: `rules` appears 13 times, so the grep instrument hits), therefore this diff cannot move the verdict of any file it does not touch. The population's one error is `e2e/live/global-setup.ts:47 no-console`, an artifact of the `--no-inline-config` flag used for this measurement — the line carries `// eslint-disable-next-line no-console`, `pnpm lint:root` passes no such flag, and this diff does not touch that file.

`check:doc-snippets` exits 2 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it wants a scoped 34-package build) — **not measured** here, neither green nor red; it is left to CI. The full farm is CI's run, not this one.

## Out of scope, reported and not filed

- The three "cannot read the required set" sentences above are now false in their read half for a networked job. A docs-only correction is a separate card.
- `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` declares **26** blocking contexts; the ruleset requires **9**, a strict subset (measured, with `Type Check` present in both and `Type Checq` in neither). Whether the other 17 *should* be required is a maintainer decision nobody has taken, and the two lists being unrelatable is only visible now that one of them can be read.
